notes: Measuring code: tests/perf/dds-roundtrip-bench and tests/perf/speed of the commit that added this measurement, built with tests/perf/speed/build.sh against the library of each label's commit (rc7: tag v1.0.0-rc.7; main and vendors: 248c262b0b0).

One exclusive board window on the Linux test host (2026-11-12 22:48 to 2026-11-13 UTC), the labels in turn: three runs of every row; runs 4 to 10 of the round trip cells of the rows hdds, zerodds-hdds-timing and zerodds (main) in the same window.

The Linux test host is an LXC guest of a virtualization host it shares with other guests; load1 is the host's. During run 1 the merge pipeline of the measured commit ran on the CI runner of the same host (load1 up to 25).

Row zerodds-hdds-timing: ZeroDDS with the reliability timing HDDS 1.1.5 uses (the reader answers a HEARTBEAT at once, the writer a NACK at once); the rows zerodds and zerodds-rust run with the specification's timing, the default. Row zerodds-rust-loan: the reader takes with a loan (crates/codec/examples/zerodds_perf_loan.rs); its header in the measurement carried the label loan.
zerodds-rust CPU comes from /proc/self/stat in ticks of 10 ms.
The vendors' apps are those of the speed pillar's build of f82a69ba373 on the Linux test host, from the same harness sources.
